verdict.rationale: Base44 documents prompt-to-app generation: you describe the app and the AI builds it. Its apps include both frontend code and backend resources, and a community user notes the generated output includes a built-in database. However, no first-party doc explicitly says one prompt generates server-side backend logic, such as functions or business rules, alongside the UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that backend logic is generated from the prompt, and hands-on evidence of a single prompt producing both layers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate both frontend UI and backend logic from a single prompt

citations.quote: Just describe what you want to build, and Base44 will bring your idea to life.
This command downloads the frontend code and backend resources from a selected app
Maor opted to include the db within the platform, rather than enable persistence externally. This really made the output great
